title: Effective Joint Equidistribution of Subspaces of Bounded Height in Rigid Adelic Spaces
summary: We prove an effective joint equidistribution theorem for $d$-dimensional $K$-subspaces, $1\le d<n$, of a fixed $n$-dimensional rigid adelic space over a number field $K$. The parameters are the height, the image in the archimedean Grassmannian, and the isometry classes of the subspace and quotient after each is rescaled to height $1$. For bounded Lipschitz test functions, the error term is power-saving with an explicit exponent. As an application, our theorem refines Thunder's asymptotic formula for subspaces of bounded height.
